Students / Special consideration

Applying for special consideration

Special consideration is for short-term circumstances outside your control that affected your performance in an assessment, such as illness or a family emergency.

Who can apply

Any enrolled student whose assessment was affected by circumstances outside your control may apply. Long-term conditions are handled through a different process.

  • Illness or injury
  • Bereavement or family emergency

How to apply

Submit the online form within two university working days of the assessment due date, and attach documentation covering the dates you were affected.
